name: Far Cry 6
scope: Solo campaign only. Do not use in co-op or online.
notes: Far Cry 6 has no anti-cheat (only Denuvo/VMProtect DRM). Only use the cheats solo: co-op sessions are online and nobody there should be affected by you.
All AOBs were checked on Steam build 11359732 (2026-09-28); not all of them have been tested in-game yet. Check first with: Vanta.exe --verify far-cry-6
Put the hash fingerprint from the --verify report into supportedVersions once the build is confirmed.
Back up your save: Ubisoft Connect\savegames\<account>\5266 (Steam version: folder 920).
Far Cry 6 heeft geen anti-cheat (alleen Denuvo/VMProtect-DRM). Gebruik de cheats alleen solo: co-op-sessies zijn online en daar hoort niemand last van jou te hebben.
